preguntas.q: Do my guests need to sign up?
preguntas.a: No. Your guests access directly through the link you send them. They don't need to create an account or download any app.

preguntas.q: What happens if two guests want to wear the same thing?
preguntas.a: The system immediately alerts the second guest when she tries to register an already-taken look. No one has more rights than another, only whoever registered first.
It means you've seen a look but haven't bought it yet. No one else can register that same look while your pre-reservation is active.

preguntas.q: Does it work for events other than weddings?
preguntas.a: Yes. NOWEAR works for any event where attire matters: weddings, communions, baptisms, engagements, birthdays, galas, award ceremonies, corporate events, institutional protocol acts and much more.
Yes. When creating your event you can define blocked colors: white for the bride, or a special family member's color.
For individuals it's a one-time payment per event. We accept card, Apple Pay and Google Pay. No subscriptions or surprises. For businesses, we offer custom packages. Write to us at support@nowear.es.
